Help Us Reach More People! 🙏

If Bible Adventist has been a blessing to you, you can help us share it with many more people.

Google Play requires us to test the Android version with 15 Android users before it can be made available to everyone.

If you have an Android device, or know someone who enjoys studying the Bible and going deeper into God's Word and has an Android device, we would be very grateful for your help.

Simply email us at YOUR_EMAIL@example.com and let us know that you would like to participate. We will add you to the Google Play testing program and provide the instructions.

Your small contribution can help this Bible and Adventist Bible Commentary reach many more people and be a blessing to them.

Thank you for helping us spread God's Word! 🙏
